title: VEON to Report 3Q26 Results on November 6, 2026
body_markdown:
08 Oct 2026


#### VEON to Report 3Q26 Results on November 6, 2026


**Dubai and New York, October 8, 2026** – VEON Ltd. (Nasdaq: VEON), a global digital operator, will release its financial and operating results for the third quarter and nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, at 9:00 GST / 0:00 ET on November 6, 2026.


Senior management will host a results presentation and earnings call at 16:00 GST / 7:00 ET the same day.


**3Q26 results conference call**


To register and access the event, please click[here](https://veon-3q-2026-results-presentation.open-exchange.net/registration) or copy and paste this link into the address bar of your browser:[https://veon-3q-2026-results-presentation.open-exchange.net/registration](https://veon-3q-2026-results-presentation.open-exchange.net/registration)


Once registered, a registration confirmation will be sent to the email address provided during registration with a link to access the webcast and dial-in details to listen to the conference call over the phone.


**Join the conversation Live**


In addition to the webcast, the conference call will also be livestreamed on YouTube. This option allows you to follow the discussion in real time from any device without the need for registration or dial-in details. Simply click[here](https://www.youtube.com/live/gNSGrwWfmAI) or copy and paste this link to the address bar of your browser:[https://www.youtube.com/live/gNSGrwWfmAI](https://www.youtube.com/live/gNSGrwWfmAI)


**Q&A**


Participants who register for the webcast will have the opportunity to ask questions live during the call. Details will be provided in your registration confirmation.


To enhance engagement with the company’s shareholders and facilitate connections with its investors, VEON is partnering with Say Technologies to allow retail and institutional shareholders to submit and upvote questions, a selection of which will be answered by VEON management during the results conference call.


Starting on October 30, 2026, at 16:00 GST / 7:00 ET, the Q&A platform will become available, and all shareholders will be able to submit and upvote questions for VEON management by visiting:[https://app.saytechnologies.com/veon-2026-q3](https://app.saytechnologies.com/veon-2026-q3) . This Q&A platform will remain open until 24 hours before the conference call. Shareholders can emailsupport@saytechnologies.com for any support inquiries.


You can also submit your questions prior to the event to VEON Investor Relations atir@veon.com .


We look forward to your participation.


Regards,
VEON
Investor Relations
ir@veon.com
